about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.name: Balneario de Caña Gorda (Guánica)
channels.legal_basis: permit PR0025917 (EPA Region 2): 40 CFR 122.41(l)(6): the permittee reports noncompliance that may endanger health or the environment to EPA orally within 24 hours and in writing within five days; 40 CFR part 127: filed electronically (NeT-SewerOverflow), and EPA publishes the reports in its sewer overflow and bypass tables
channels.note: Balneario de Caña Gorda (Guánica) reports an overflow or bypass to EPA Region 2 within 24 hours and in writing within five days; the electronic report is published in EPA's overflow tables, which the overflow module reads daily (1 permit(s) in this row). No public notice of its own is required by Puerto Rico law.

channels.agency: Departamento de Recursos Naturales y Ambientales (DRNA)
channels.name: Departamento de Recursos Naturales y Ambientales (DRNA), Programa de Monitoría de Playas y Notificación Pública (weekly beach notices)
channels.legal_basis: BEACH Act, 33 U.S.C. 1346(c): a state or territory receiving a beach grant notifies the public when a coastal recreation water exceeds the water quality criteria
channels.authority: Departamento de Recursos Naturales y Ambientales (DRNA)
channels.note: DRNA's weekly notice lists the beaches whose enterococci samples exceed the Beach Action Value as not fit for bathers (280 notices since 2019-10; 36 stations in its table). Read by its own module every refresh. No terms of use stated on the API.

channels.name: Autoridad de Acueductos y Alcantarillados de Puerto Rico (PRASA)
channels.legal_basis: NPDES permit PR0021555 (2021), CSO permit conditions, Nine Minimum Controls 8: "The permittee shall implement a public notification process to inform citizens of when and where CSOs occur. The process must include (a) a mechanism to alert persons of the occurrence of CSOs and (b) a system to determine the nature and duration of conditions that are potentially harmful for users of receiving waters due to CSOs."; United States v. PRASA, No. 3:15-cv-02283 (D.P.R.), consent decree (2016) as modified in 2023 (EPA Region 2 public notice of 2023-07-05): communication to the public through PRASA's website of the discharges from the permitted combined sewer outfalls and their estimated volume
channels.note: PRASA's combined sewer pages (Spanish and English): the outfall map, precautions, the work under way and a form for the public to report an overflow (reCAPTCHA). On 2026-11-04 no overflow event or volume was posted, although the 2023 decree modification calls for it. Watched for a change; no records are made from the page.

channels.name: Autoridad de Acueductos y Alcantarillados de Puerto Rico (PRASA)
channels.legal_basis: NPDES permit PR0021555 (2021), CSO permit conditions, Nine Minimum Controls 8: "The permittee shall implement a public notification process to inform citizens of when and where CSOs occur. The process must include (a) a mechanism to alert persons of the occurrence of CSOs and (b) a system to determine the nature and duration of conditions that are potentially harmful for users of receiving waters due to CSOs."
channels.note: The permit's mechanism to alert persons when and where CSOs occur: no alert, sign list or event page was found on PRASA's site; no web channel found.
